mapper.sql: u.user_id AS "userId", u.login_id AS "loginId", u.password_hash AS "passwordHash", u.staff_no AS "staffNo", u.system_use_yn AS "systemUseYn", u.account_status AS "accountStatus", s.staff_name AS "staffName", s.organization_code AS "organizationCode", o.organization_name AS "organizationName", s.position_name AS "positionName", s.rank_name AS "rankName", s.employment_status AS "employmentStatus", s.retired_at AS "retiredAt", s.last_synced_at AS "lastSyncedAt"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM app_user u LEFT JOIN korus_staff_snapshot s ON s.staff_no=u.staff_no LEFT JOIN organization o ON o.organization_code=s.organization_code WHERE u.login_id=#{loginId}

SELECT FROM user_session us JOIN app_user u ON u.user_id=us.user_id LEFT JOIN korus_staff_snapshot s ON s.staff_no=u.staff_no LEFT JOIN organization o ON o.organization_code=s.organization_code WHERE us.session_id=#{sessionId} AND us.status='ACTIVE' AND us.expires_at>now()
SELECT role_code FROM user_role_assignment WHERE user_id=#{userId}::uuid AND status='ACTIVE' AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to>=current_date) ORDER BY role_code

SELECT , COALESCE(string_agg(ura.role_code, ',' ORDER BY ura.role_code), '') AS "roleCodes" FROM app_user u LEFT JOIN korus_staff_snapshot s ON s.staff_no=u.staff_no LEFT JOIN organization o ON o.organization_code=s.organization_code LEFT JOIN user_role_assignment ura ON ura.user_id=u.user_id AND ura.status='ACTIVE' AND s.staff_no LIKE concat('%',#{staffNo},'%')AND s.staff_name LIKE concat('%',#{staffName},'%')AND s.organization_code=#{organizationCode}AND s.rank_name=#{rankName}AND s.employment_status=#{employmentStatus}AND u.system_use_yn=#{systemUseYn}AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_role_assignment r WHERE r.user_id=u.user_id AND r.role_code=#{roleCode} AND r.status='ACTIVE') GROUP BY u.user_id,s.staff_no,o.organization_name ORDER BY s.staff_no
SELECT FROM app_user u LEFT JOIN korus_staff_snapshot s ON s.staff_no=u.staff_no LEFT JOIN organization o ON o.organization_code=s.organization_code WHERE u.user_id=#{userId}::uuid
mapper.update: UPDATE app_user SET system_use_yn=#{systemUseYn}, account_status=CASE WHEN #{systemUseYn}='Y' THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'INACTIVE' END, updated_at=now() WHERE user_id=#{userId}::uuid
UPDATE user_role_assignment SET status='REVOKED', updated_at=now() WHERE user_id=#{userId}::uuid AND status='ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_role_assignment(user_id, role_code, grant_type, valid_from, approver_user_id, status) VALUES (#{userId}::uuid, #{roleCode}, 'MANUAL', current_date, #{approverUserId}::uuid, 'ACTIVE')
mapper.select: SELECT organization_id AS "organizationId", organization_code AS "organizationCode", organization_name AS "organizationName", organization_type AS "organizationType", use_yn AS "useYn" FROM organization AND organization_code LIKE concat('%',#{organizationCode},'%')AND organization_name LIKE concat('%',#{organizationName},'%')AND organization_type=#{organizationType}AND use_yn=#{useYn} ORDER BY organization_code

SELECT o.organization_id AS "organizationId", o.organization_code AS "organizationCode", o.organization_name AS "organizationName", o.organization_type AS "organizationType", r.parent_organization_id AS "parentOrganizationId", o.use_yn AS "useYn" FROM organization o LEFT JOIN organization_relation_history r ON r.organization_id=o.organization_id AND r.status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY COALESCE(r.parent_organization_id,o.organization_id), o.organization_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO organization_relation_history(relation_id, organization_id, parent_organization_id, valid_from, valid_to, change_reason, status) VALUES (#{relationId}::uuid, #{organizationId}::uuid, NULLIF(#{parentOrganizationId}, '')::uuid, #{validFrom}::date, NULLIF(#{validTo}, '')::date, #{changeReason}, 'ACTIVE')
mapper.select: SELECT role_code AS "roleCode", role_name AS "roleName", purpose, grant_criteria AS "grantCriteria", default_data_scope AS "defaultDataScope", use_yn AS "useYn" FROM role AND use_yn=#{useYn} ORDER BY role_code
SELECT role_code AS "roleCode", role_name AS "roleName", purpose, grant_criteria AS "grantCriteria", default_data_scope AS "defaultDataScope", use_yn AS "useYn" FROM role WHERE role_code=#{roleCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO role(role_code, role_name, purpose, grant_criteria, default_data_scope, use_yn) VALUES (#{roleCode}, #{roleName}, #{purpose}, #{grantCriteria}, #{defaultDataScope}, COALESCE(#{useYn},'Y'))
mapper.update: UPDATE role SET role_name=#{roleName}, purpose=#{purpose}, grant_criteria=#{grantCriteria}, default_data_scope=#{defaultDataScope}, use_yn=COALESCE(#{useYn}, use_yn), updated_at=now() WHERE role_code=#{roleCode}
mapper.select: SELECT ura.assignment_id AS "assignmentId", ura.user_id AS "userId", s.staff_name AS "staffName", ura.role_code AS "roleCode", r.role_name AS "roleName", ura.grant_type AS "grantType", ura.valid_from AS "validFrom", ura.valid_to AS "validTo", ura.approver_user_id AS "approverUserId", ura.status FROM user_role_assignment ura JOIN app_user u ON u.user_id=ura.user_id LEFT JOIN korus_staff_snapshot s ON s.staff_no=u.staff_no JOIN role r ON r.role_code=ura.role_code AND ura.user_id=#{userId}::uuidAND ura.role_code=#{roleCode}AND ura.status=#{status} ORDER BY s.staff_name, ura.role_code

SELECT assignment_id AS "assignmentId", user_id AS "userId", role_code AS "roleCode", grant_type AS "grantType", valid_from AS "validFrom", valid_to AS "validTo", approver_user_id AS "approverUserId", status FROM user_role_assignment WHERE assignment_id=#{assignmentId}::uuid
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_role_assignment(assignment_id, user_id, role_code, grant_type, valid_from, valid_to, approver_user_id, status) VALUES (#{assignmentId}::uuid, #{userId}::uuid, #{roleCode}, #{grantType}, #{validFrom}::date, NULLIF(#{validTo}, '')::date, #{approverUserId}::uuid, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_role_assignment SET status='REVOKED', updated_at=now() WHERE assignment_id=#{assignmentId}::uuid
mapper.select: SELECT menu_id AS "menuId", parent_menu_id AS "parentMenuId", menu_level AS "menuLevel", display_order AS "displayOrder", menu_name AS "menuName", screen_id AS "screenId", url_path AS "urlPath", icon_name AS "iconName", business_area AS "businessArea", description, use_yn AS "useYn" FROM menu AND menu_name LIKE concat('%',#{menuName},'%')AND screen_id LIKE concat('%',#{screenId},'%')AND use_yn=#{useYn} ORDER BY menu_level, display_order

SELECT menu_id AS "menuId", parent_menu_id AS "parentMenuId", menu_level AS "menuLevel", display_order AS "displayOrder", menu_name AS "menuName", screen_id AS "screenId", url_path AS "urlPath", icon_name AS "iconName", business_area AS "businessArea", description, use_yn AS "useYn" FROM menu WHERE menu_id=#{menuId}::uuid
mapper.update: UPDATE menu SET menu_name=#{menuName}, screen_id=#{screenId}, url_path=#{urlPath}, icon_name=#{iconName}, business_area=#{businessArea}, description=#{description}, use_yn=COALESCE(#{useYn}, use_yn), updated_at=now() WHERE menu_id=#{menuId}::uuid
UPDATE menu SET parent_menu_id=NULLIF(#{parentMenuId}, '')::uuid, updated_at=now() WHERE menu_id=#{menuId}::uuid
UPDATE menu SET display_order=#{displayOrder}, updated_at=now() WHERE menu_id=#{menuId}::uuid
mapper.select: SELECT p.permission_id AS "permissionId", p.menu_id AS "menuId", m.menu_name AS "menuName", p.subject_type AS "subjectType", p.subject_id AS "subjectId", p.access_allowed AS "accessAllowed", p.function_allowed AS "functionAllowed", p.decision_effect AS "decisionEffect", p.use_yn AS "useYn" FROM menu_permission p JOIN menu m ON m.menu_id=p.menu_id AND p.subject_type=#{subjectType}AND p.subject_id=#{subjectId}AND p.menu_id=#{menuId}::uuid ORDER BY m.display_order
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO menu_permission(permission_id,menu_id,subject_type,subject_id,access_allowed,function_allowed,decision_effect,use_yn) VALUES (#{permissionId}::uuid,#{menuId}::uuid,#{subjectType},#{subjectId},#{accessAllowed},#{functionAllowed},#{decisionEffect},'Y') ON CONFLICT (menu_id, subject_type, subject_id) DO UPDATE SET access_allowed=EXCLUDED.access_allowed, function_allowed=EXCLUDED.function_allowed, decision_effect=EXCLUDED.decision_effect, updated_at=now()
mapper.select: SELECT group_id AS "groupId", group_name AS "groupName", description, managing_department AS "managingDepartment", use_yn AS "useYn" FROM code_group AND group_id LIKE concat('%',#{groupId},'%')AND group_name LIKE concat('%',#{groupName},'%')AND use_yn=#{useYn} ORDER BY group_id
SELECT group_id AS "groupId", group_name AS "groupName", description, managing_department AS "managingDepartment", use_yn AS "useYn" FROM code_group WHERE group_id=#{groupId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO code_group(group_id, group_name, description, managing_department, use_yn) VALUES (#{groupId}, #{groupName}, #{description}, #{managingDepartment}, COALESCE(#{useYn},'Y'))
mapper.update: UPDATE code_group SET group_name=#{groupName}, description=#{description}, managing_department=#{managingDepartment}, use_yn=COALESCE(#{useYn}, use_yn), updated_at=now() WHERE group_id=#{groupId}
mapper.select: SELECT detail_code_id AS "detailCodeId", group_id AS "groupId", code_value AS "codeValue", code_name AS "codeName", parent_detail_code_id AS "parentDetailCodeId", sort_order AS "sortOrder", extra_attributes AS "extraAttributes", valid_from AS "validFrom", valid_to AS "validTo", use_yn AS "useYn" FROM detail_code AND group_id=#{groupId}AND code_value LIKE concat('%',#{codeValue},'%')AND code_name LIKE concat('%',#{codeName},'%')AND use_yn=#{useYn} ORDER BY sort_order

SELECT detail_code_id AS "detailCodeId", group_id AS "groupId", code_value AS "codeValue", code_name AS "codeName", parent_detail_code_id AS "parentDetailCodeId", sort_order AS "sortOrder", extra_attributes AS "extraAttributes", valid_from AS "validFrom", valid_to AS "validTo", use_yn AS "useYn" FROM detail_code WHERE group_id=#{groupId} AND code_value=#{codeValue}
mapper.update: UPDATE detail_code SET code_name=#{codeName}, sort_order=COALESCE(#{sortOrder}, sort_order), extra_attributes=COALESCE(NULLIF(#{extraAttributes}, '')::jsonb, extra_attributes), valid_from=NULLIF(#{validFrom}, '')::date, valid_to=NULLIF(#{validTo}, '')::date, use_yn=COALESCE(#{useYn}, use_yn), updated_at=now() WHERE group_id=#{groupId} AND code_value=#{codeValue}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_session(session_id, user_id, expires_at, status) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{userId}::uuid, now()+interval '8 hours', 'ACTIVE')
mapper.update: UPDATE user_session SET status='REVOKED', updated_at=now() WHERE session_id=#{sessionId}
